capabilities: Read EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and CBZ books with themes, fonts, page turns and a focus mode
Save highlights as Markdown notes with deep links back to the exact passage
Import highlights from Kindle, KOReader, Annotator, Weave, Elton and Readest
Maintain a library with covers, shelves, collections and reading progress built on notes
Read aloud with system voices or optional AI voices from your own API key or Ollama
extras: Freemium: all reader features are free and offline; Octavo Cloud is an optional paid subscription adding cloud library, send-to-email inbox, OCR, neural voices, KOReader sync and hosted AI. The settings tab contains three static, bundled promotional links (Octavo Cloud, LightningPDF, developer site). Open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later; full guide is on an external website.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in reader for EPUB and other ebook formats, and highlights made in separate reader apps do not live in the vault as linked notes.

relations.evidence: Annotator highlights come across with Import highlights → Annotator (colours and comments included).
optional AI (your own API key or a local model through Ollama)
Install the BRAT plugin, choose "Add beta plugin" and enter meaLuda/OctavoRelease.

requires.name: Anthropic or OpenAI key for AI features

summary: Book reader for EPUB, PDF, MOBI and other formats that saves highlights as Markdown notes in the vault with deep links back to the passage.
